effect.sun-moon: While this Pokémon is in battle, weather can still be in play, but will not have any of its effects. This ability functions identically to Air Lock.
effect.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: While this Pokémon is in battle, weather can still be in play, but will not have any of its effects. This ability functions identically to Air Lock.
effect.lets-go-pikachu-lets-go-eevee: While this Pokémon is in battle, weather can still be in play, but will not have any of its effects. This ability functions identically to Air Lock.

short_effect.sun-moon: Negates all effects of weather, but does not prevent the weather itself.
short_effect.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Negates all effects of weather, but does not prevent the weather itself.
short_effect.lets-go-pikachu-lets-go-eevee: Negates all effects of weather, but does not prevent the weather itself.
